headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredSmallMask_entry
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ) (U : ℕ) (i : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveMargins xs).length)
  (j : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveMargins ys).length),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) U i j =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys) U ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveIndexEquiv xs) i)
      ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveIndexEquiv ys) j)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceReference_conditions
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference →
    2 ≤ (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveMargins xs).length ∧
      2 ≤ (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveMargins ys).length ∧
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys)
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys))) ∧
          0 <
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys,
                    List.ofFn (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs))).length ∧
            0 <
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
                  (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys,
                    List.ofFn (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys))).length

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceReferenceWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ),
  ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j →
    ∀ (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
      (start :
        Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys) (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceCutoff xs ys) 7)
      (h : ℕ),
      ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceReferenceWord xs ys hb start h))
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
        ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceDeterministic_restored_uniform
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.deterministic →
    ∀
      (X :
        OAI.ContingencyTables.Table (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin xs)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.filteredMargin ys)),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.restoreZeroMarginListsLaw xs ys (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.pointLaw X) =
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
